hero.text: We build modern, trustworthy websites and digital systems so local customers find your business on Google and understand it at a glance.
hero.trustLine: No obligation · Personal advice · Local to Lake Constance

problems.title: Good work alone doesn't bring new customers.

items.title: Not found on Google
items.text: Customers search for your service in your town and find your competitors first.

items.title: Too few reviews
items.text: You have plenty of happy customers, but hardly anyone leaves a review. So new customers trust someone else.

items.title: Enquiries get lost
items.text: Calls while you're working, unanswered WhatsApp messages, no online booking: every missed enquiry is a lost customer.

items.title: No job applicants
items.text: You're looking for staff, but without a strong online presence hardly anyone applies.

problems.footer: ZielTakt solves exactly that: with one system instead of loose pieces.

about.p1: ZielTakt is a digital growth studio from Konstanz. We build more than websites for local businesses: we combine design, visibility and automation into one system built to win new customers.
about.p2: Every website is made to measure: no site builder, no stock templates, but thoughtful design that fits your business and your customers. We know the Lake Constance region because we live and work here. And we speak German, English and Arabic.

services.text: We connect your website, Google visibility, leads, bookings and tracking into one system that grows your business online.

process.title: Four steps to your finished website.

steps.title: Get to know you
steps.desc: Free intro call. We clarify your goals, your customers and what the website needs to achieve.

steps.title: Concept & design
steps.desc: Layout, colours, fonts and content are designed. You see everything in advance and give feedback.

steps.title: Development
steps.desc: We build the website: responsive, fast, secure and easy to maintain.

steps.title: Launch & handover
steps.desc: The website goes live, Google visibility is set up, and you get a short walkthrough.

partner.title: Know a business that needs a new website?
partner.text: Photographers, print shops, consultants or simply good contacts: if you refer a client who signs with us, you receive {{pct}}% of the project value as a thank-you. No contract, no small print.

area.title: Konstanz and the whole region.
area.mapLabel: Map of the service area around Lake Constance
area.text: We work with businesses in Konstanz and across the region – personally, quickly and reliably. Practice, trade, restaurant or retail: we know the region and your customers.
area.remote: Outside the region we work with you remotely, by video call and WhatsApp, anywhere in Germany and Switzerland.
area.studioNote: Virtual office · personal meetings by appointment

items.q: Can we work together in English?
items.a: Yes. We advise you in English, German or Arabic, by phone, WhatsApp or in person. Your website can be in German, English or several languages.

items.q: How long does a website take?
items.a: Depending on the package: Start is live in about 7 days, Pro in 2–3 weeks, Partner in 3–4 weeks. The individual steps are shown in the Process section above, from the intro call to launch.

items.q: What does it really cost in the end?
items.a: ZielTakt Komplett consists of a one-time setup and a fixed monthly fee: Start €790 + €149/month, Pro €1,490 + €349/month, Partner €2,900 + €590–790/month plus ad budget, each with a 12-month minimum term. After the intro call you receive a fixed written quote listing all costs, including any running costs for tools or software.

items.q: Can I edit my website myself later?
items.a: Yes. We build on an easy-to-maintain system so you can change texts, images and appointments yourself. If you'd rather hand it off: small changes are included in every monthly package and we take care of them for you.

After launch we hand over the website, show you the most important features and set up your Google visibility (Google Business Profile, Search Console). After that we look after technology, security and visibility as part of your monthly package.

items.q: Do you work with clients in Switzerland?
items.a: Yes. We're based in Konstanz, right on the border, and work with clients across the region, including the Swiss side. All prices are also available in CHF. Personal meetings by appointment.
